text:
support-ops: Hey team — incoming customer escalation (Zendesk #82741). Hosted API returning intermittent 5xx and a lot of p95/p99 timeouts since 08:12 UTC. They see ~25% of requests 504/502, most from the same tenant. :rotating_light:
eng-sre: I see alerts — ingress queue depth hit 92% on gw-prod-03 and continuous-batcher backlog spiked. Paging runtime oncall.
oncall-jay: on it, looking at queues and batcher metrics now.
eng-runtime: can you paste the tenant id and sample request IDs? We need to correlate with batching logs.
support-ops: tenant: tenant-acme-42, sample req IDs: r-9842f, r-9843a, r-9849b. Customer says this happens on long-sequence requests and on short chat bursts.
eng-sre: logs from gw-prod-03 show enqueue latency increasing, dequeue throughput flat. Queue depth policy max_inflight=1500 was hit and we started early-rejects.
eng-runtime: that explains 502/504s — gateway began rejecting to protect downstream. Continuous batcher backlog shows KV-cache warmups taking longer (cold kvcache churn).
maria-ds: customer traffic pattern shows a sudden shift to lots of long-context calls (~1024 tokens) with ~20 concurrent streams. Combined with small model (quant) warmups it creates long tail.
support-ops: customer wants repro steps and ETA. They report service interruptions for 10+ minutes.
eng-runtime: immediate mitigation: set per-tenant max_inflight lower for tenant-acme-42 and enable canary fallback to smaller model variant (lighter quant) for long sequences. Can we push config?
eng-sre: I can throttle their token rate at ingress and add a temporary route to fallback-model-v2. Doing now.
deploy-bot: deploy started: route-change/tenant-acme-42-throttle -> gw-prod (by eng-sre) (ID: dpl-8432).
eng-runtime: also adding a short-term KV pre-warm for the models serving that tenant; will trigger warmup on pool nodes to reduce cold kvcache latency.
oncall-jay: adding a one-off autoscale bump to dedicated pool for 10 minutes to drain backlog.
maria-ds: note — quality might drop slightly on fallback model; flagged for cust-success to notify customer.
cust-success: reaching out to customer to explain mitigation and potential short drift in outputs.
support-ops: reproduction notes for postmortem: 1) tenant generates burst of long sequences (~1k tokens) from 20+ clients in <60s 2) gateway enqueues, batcher KV misses cause per-request processing time to jump 3) queue depth hits policy threshold -> early rejects and 502/504 4) clients retry aggressively -> retry amplification -> deeper backlog.
eng-runtime: collecting traces now. Please provide these artifacts for SOC/PM: span IDs, kvcache miss rates, batch sizes, enqueue/dequeue histograms.
support-ops: pasted a small snippet of the most relevant logs:
```
[2026-03-17T08:12:14Z] gw-prod-03 ENQUEUE req=r-9842f tenant=tenant-acme-42 depth=1496
[2026-03-17T08:12:15Z] cbatcher-prod kvcache MISS model=m-instruct-v1 req=r-9842f latency=320ms
[2026-03-17T08:12:18Z] gw-prod-03 EARLY_REJECT req=r-9849b code=502 reason=queue_depth
[2026-03-17T08:12:20Z] gateway REJECT_RETRY req=r-9843a attempt=2
```
eng-sre: thanks — I pulled the tracing spans; attaching link: https://internal-observability/redwood/spans/trace-6533219876 (internal only). kvcache miss rate jumped to 74% for that model in the 5m window.
eng-runtime: action items: (A) short-term throttle + fallback (done) (B) pre-warm/workload-aware kvcache (in progress) (C) adjust queue depth watermarking to be tenant-aware and increase early-warning sliding window (next patch) (D) postmortem with runbook updates.
oncall-jay: adding runbook note: when continuous-batcher backlog > 60s, mark model kvcache cold and trigger auto-warm on pool.
maria-ds: add an Optimize suggestion to recommend smaller context models or progressive chunking for tenants with heavy longseq patterns.
cust-success: customer acknowledged mitigation and accepted fallback while we stabilize. They asked for ETA on permanent fix. I'll relay that we plan a config/patch in the next 24-48h and a PM/Eng follow-up.
support-ops: creating JIRA ENG-12987 to track the full fix + postmortem. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-12987
eng-runtime: tagging this as Sev-2 for now; we'll update once the backlog drains and metrics normalize.
oncall-jay: backlog dropped below 30% by 08:22 UTC after throttle + autoscale. P95 tail latency down from 4.8s to 320ms.
eng-sre: closing alert: ingress-gw-queue-depth-gw-prod-03. Will keep monitoring.
support-ops: thanks all — please add any extra notes to ENG-12987.
maria-ds: adding a follow-up eval to quantify quality delta on fallback model vs primary for the customer's prompt set.
eng-runtime: will prepare a short writeup for the postmortem with perf graphs and the patch diff.
cust-success: customer happy with update, keeping ticket open for the patch. :thumbsup:
